(3) The camera returns to the clinic setting, focusing on a close-up of the woman's face. She uses her index finger to touch the skin around her chin and upper lip to demonstrate where acne usually appears in adults, maintaining a serious but helpful expression. A hand with dark red nail polish enters the frame to gently touch and point out the affected area. Red graphical circles appear on her face to simulate the location of skin issues discussed in the advice. (6) Final scene shows a static white background with the black DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC logo. It displays social media handles, phone numbers, and addresses for two clinic locations in traditional Chinese characters and English.
